lesson: The delegated companion sandbox mounts .claude/ and .codex/ READ-ONLY regardless of declared write scope. A worker whose scope includes .claude/settings.json or .codex/hooks.json must NOT edit or pause on those two files: implement everything else, assert their intended content via generated init/upgrade targets and fixtures, and report the exact final command strings — the orchestrator lands the two root files verbatim through a ledgered degraded window (precedent Q-0051-7425).
